reviews.review: Dear god this game is so good. Buy it, wait for a sale if you want, but just buy it. The multiplayer is sort of dead, but the single player campaign alone is worth it. Weapons and mechanics are a blast to use, and everything feels surprisingly smooth. Graphics are nice, and the environments are somewhat varied. I love this game, it's very good.

This game is extremely fun, I don't know if there are active people online but I play with my friends and girlfriend, it has a vs mode and an horde mode, you can customize your marines. Best 3rd person shooter unlike the gargabe EC, or the failure of DoW 3

[b]N.B.[/b] This game is considered not canonical. Ultramarines care about Codex Astartest and Capitan main duty is to comand his company(100 marines). So people who have knowladge about Warhammer can be dissapointed. (But they probaly know about it all already).

I will try to write about the game itself.

[h1]Pros[/h1]
[i]Visual design.[/i] Game looks pretty good. Picturesque location, character and opponnents design are good and graffic is quite decent (well taking notion about release in 2011, but i would say good even now)
[i]Unique mechanic.[/i] Game has unique conjunction of slashing with melee wepons and shooter. I mean it can really be played either way(Never touching heavy rifles or using only them, up to you). Usually slasher have some ranged weapon that is used as asset or is good against certain types of enemies (Darksiders, Dmc etc.). Or shooters have some kind of melee attack when enemy gets to close or it is a finisher to gain some extra points or some kind of rewarding mechanic (Tomb Rider, Doom). So like I think this is actually quite "outstandig" feature of this game.
[i]Fights.[/i] Beating opponents has some how "satisfying" feel in it, well thats how I put it. I dont mean only slowmoution finishers, its more about the feeling of blow impact. And jumpucks are fun.

[h1]Cons[/h1]
[i]Variety.[/i] The game lacks veraety in every aspect. Locations are drawn good but it is basicaly three types whole game, and there is no places that feel special or magnificent. "Combos"... well basicaly four variation of one. Enemies diferenceate mainly by weapon they shoot from, and even so there is not much of them. And the most shamefull  -- bosses, actually only two.(with some mini-wonna-be).
[i]Fight mechanic.[/i] Few combos means u dont have to do much, so it feels repetative. Well u can use granade, then shoot one,  slash other with sword, shoot other, changed your gun and shoot... But game does not encourage you to that so it is up to you to entertain yourself.
[i]Opponents.[/i] AI does not behave too diferently. (But I must admit short moves left-right when you try to shoot is great game idea)
[i]Plot.[/i] You mostly run some where to get something or activate something or shoot something. And story telling isn't very good. Feels less like tactic military operation more like some gang activity.
[i]Difficulty.[/i] Does not feel challenging even if you die few times. (I think it is actually what can save the gameplay, if it becames really hard to win. Then you probably will be occupied with improving your strategy and make beating the game feel more rewarding.)

[h1]Recomendation:[/h1]
I would not recomend to buy it for full price. Read a few more review and watch some gameplay. If you don't feel any interest, that it. If it is otherwise than I dont think that you will regret playing. I mean game is medicore, but provided you dont have a habit of droping a game becase it is not that good, I would recomend giving it a try. Well there isn't much Really good games out there...

... there is only war.

Best 3rd person shooter outside of Gears, but with a better story.  Mostly faithful to the Warhammer 40k IP.  Multiplayer gameplay is great, but every other aspect is lacking.  Grab it on sale and you won't be disappointed.  The DLC is only really necessary if you get into the multiplayer.
